made_by: Claude (Claude Code cloud session, project thread 'Fritigern wagon scene')
method: Procedural, generated at load time by paper.js and props.js, plus one imported model: the Intercisa ridge helmet GLB from the paper helmet study. Shield designs and atmosphere textures are drawn on canvases at runtime. No external images or scans.
grammar_source: Rules ported from tools/paper-warrior/paper.py on branch claude/project-thread-tdiiox (facet, plates, stiffen, matte paper material), adapted to three.js: facet, tint, plate, strip, pleats, creases.
era_reference: docs/fritigern/EQUIPMENT.md (late Roman and Tervingi Gothic equipment, 376 to 378 AD). Historical sources cited there: Ammianus Marcellinus book 31, Notitia Dignitatum, helmet finds from Intercisa, Berkasovo and Deurne.

assets.builder: assets/ridge_helmet.glb (tools/paper-helmet/out/ridge_helmet.glb, PR #45, papercraft grammar, unfitted placeholder); props.js ridgeHelmet() is the fallback
assets.notes: Worn by the Roman guards, recoloured grey card at load. 704 triangles. Provenance: tools/paper-helmet/provenance.json on main.
The officer's helmet Fritigern carries back. Gilded, brow band, nasal, glass gems. To be replaced by the paper helmet study's ridge-helmet when ready.
Late Roman oval shield, generic ring-and-spoke design, not a specific Notitia unit.
Four-wheeled wagon, hide or wool cover on hoops.
Roman (mail, ridge helmet, long-sleeved tunic, trousers, cloak), Goth, woman, child.
Late Roman wall with projecting towers either side of an arched gate.

assets.id: tent, campfire, torch, stake, trees, hills, terrain

assets.notes: Gate light shafts, glows, ground mist, dust; all canvas gradients.
Cinema, storybook, game HUD and Telltale-style overlays. All text written for this scene; Telltale is a style reference only (see docs/oracle/BACKLOG.md).

dramatic_licence: Alaric as Fritigern's son is a story choice; history doesn't record Alaric's father.
Fritigern returning wounded with an officer's helmet is invented; Ammianus says he talked his way out of the Marcianople banquet.
Wulfila, the companion who supports Fritigern, is an invented character.
